title: Speech-to-text agent sends base64 audio (as printed)

source.clause: §11.3 Figure 9, NLIP message format for Speech to Text Agent
source.note: verbatim: copied exactly as the figure prints it, including the content string.

notes: The figure's content is 21 base64 characters followed by one `=`. No base64 string can have 21 data characters (21 mod 4 == 1), with or without padding, so the committee's own figure does not decode: the expectation is a base64 error. This is the clearest conflict in the corpus — see 09-figure-9-binary-webm-repaired for the same message with a payload that decodes. An implementation that accepts this input is not applying ECMA-430 §6.4 / ECMA-432 §7.2 base64 at all.
